purpose: Frozen synthetic feasibility benchmark, not product or device qualification

estimator_settings.arming: Explicit operator rest/recenter frame after real Fusion startup/recovery; no motion-onset detector
estimator_settings.fault_policy: Clear velocity, fractional HID carry and arming on nonfinite data, invalid cadence, startup, overrange or acceleration recovery; cadence/data faults also restart Fusion; require explicit recenter to rearm

fixture_contract.input: Causal ordered samples with analytic interval-mean world translation acceleration, endpoint specific force and interval-mean body angular rate; ideal gravity and fixed scale unless explicitly perturbed
fixture_contract.orientation_oracle: Same C estimator and Fusion flags/gates, replacing only compensated acceleration by analytic ground truth; privileged diagnostic, never firmware evidence
fixture_contract.warmup: Static physical pose, no pointer output, no skipped Fusion startup
fixture_contract.axis_mapping: Freeze estimated grip-to-world matrix at explicit rest/recenter, rotate earth acceleration back into that grip; X/Y map to pointer X/Y
limits: No device noise model is established
Perfect interval-mean acceleration is favorable to integration
No physical position state or endpoint-position criterion
No automatic zero-velocity claim from low acceleration
No retrospective correction or future data in C estimator
Pure rotation means rotation about sensor center, not a displaced wrist pivot

execution_policy: Freeze protocol, generator, estimator, dependency hashes and generated input SHA before compiling/running the estimator. Preserve the first run and every failure. Never change expectations or parameters in response to observed outcomes. Any defect repair needs a separate revision and retains the first run.
